ITEM 1 | Crumbly, opaque white mass with irregular rough edges and small curds, covering the upper-left and center of the plate in a loose heap about 13 cm across and 2 cm tall; matte surface, no sheen, holds a clumped shape but breaks apart at the edges | 180
ITEM 2 | Cubes of orange-fleshed root vegetable, about 2 cm pieces, with browned, slightly caramelized edges and some darker charred patches; matte, slightly glossy where glazed, sitting in the lower-left of the plate | 150
ITEM 3 | Pinkish-brown cubes, about 1.5 cm, with soft-looking, dense texture and darker edges, mixed among the orange cubes at the lower center | 40
ITEM 4 | Bright red fleshy fruit cut into wedges and cubes about 2 cm, juicy-looking with moist surface, with pale whitish rind edges, arranged along the right side and lower right of the plate | 170
ITEM 5 | Two small, smooth, dark reddish-brown whole grapes, about 2 cm diameter, glossy skin, sitting at the upper right beside the white mass | 15
